generated_query: I'm building a Flutter app to track daily habits. I have a JSON file with sample data: each habit has an id, name, and a count of how many times it was done today. I need to set up a clean project structure, display the habits in a scrollable list on a home screen using Material 3, allow the user to tap a "done" button to increment the count (updating the state immediately), and tap a habit to navigate to a detail screen showing its name and current count. There should also be a settings screen accessible from an icon in the app bar. I want to use Riverpod for state management and GoRouter for navigation. Could you help me scaffold the project, write the provider for the habits list (including an async fetch from the JSON and a method to increment a habit's count), set up the routes, and implement the UI for the home and detail screens? I also need the count persisted in memory for now, but keep the repository pattern so I can swap in a database later.
